title: embeddings-rerank-incident-scratch-samira-ali-2026-03-11
content:
SUMMARY:
- Quick scratchpad for the weird embeddings/rerank anomalies observed on 2026-03-10 evening. Running notes, commands tried, errors, and hypotheses.

INCIDENT TL;DR:
- Symptoms: sudden latency spikes on rerank endpoint and some requests failing with dimension mismatch errors.
- First seen: ~2026-03-10 20:34 UTC by user logs and SLO alerts.
- Affected routes: /v1/rerank (internal service), batch rerank jobs via job-runner. Mostly traffic to model text-embed-002-v2 and reranker built on top.

WHAT I SAW (raw logs/snippets):
- Example error from rerank-service logs:
  [2026-03-10T20:37:12.914Z] ERROR request_id=0a7f3b6 route=/v1/rerank user_id=acct_123 message="DimensionMismatch: expected=1536 got=1024" stack="..."
- Latency trace for same window (sample):
  request_id=0a7f3b6 | queue_ms=1200 | compute_ms=480 | total_ms=1700
  request_id=1b9d2e4 | queue_ms=50   | compute_ms=220 | total_ms=290
- Notice: dimension mismatch appears intermittently ~1/50 requests but latency spikes affect a larger % (~10-15%).

COMMANDS & REPROS I RAN:
- Reproduce embeddings call locally (python):
  python - <<'PY'
  import requests, json
  r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings', json={
      'model': 'text-embed-002-v2',
      'input': ['hello world']
  }, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer x'})
  print(r.status_code, r.text)
  PY
- Curl that returns mismatch sometimes:
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"text-embed-002-v2","input":["test"]}'
  -> sometimes returns 200 with 'embedding': [..1536 floats..] but sometimes returns 200 with shorter vector or returns 500 with message "DimensionMismatch: expected 1536 got 1024"
- Replayed a stuck batch from replay store via job-runner shim: observed the job runner increased batch size to 8 due to recent config change (batch_cap=32, dynamic_batching=true). Job logs:
  job_id=jr-998 queueing_time=1400ms batch_size=8

OBSERVATIONS / PATTERNS:
- Dimension mismatch always reports expected 1536 (old system default). Some embeddings are 1024.
- 1024 vectors correlate with requests routed to a specific node pool (nodepool-eu-quant) - suspicion: this pool is running an older/alternate model binary with 1024-dim output (maybe a v1 embedder).
- Latency spikes correlate with queueing on nodepool-eu-quant during autoscaler events.
- Rate of mismatch increased after the deployment at 2026-03-10 19:50 UTC (deploy tag: rerank-deploy-2026-03-10T19:45).

ERROR SNIPPETS (copied from logs):
- "DimensionMismatch: expected=1536 got=1024"
- "KVCache miss for model text-embed-002-v2 variant: fallback to quantized-v1"
- "Batcher: adjusted batch_size from 2 -> 8 due to dynamic_batching config change"

HYPOTHESES (ranked):
1) Model variant routing bug: new rollout added a variant (quantized-v1) with 1024-dim outputs; routing policy incorrectly classifies variant as compatible (should be incompatible) -> dimension mismatch.
2) Serving binary mismatch: some nodepools still running older embedding binary compiled for 1024 outputs; rollout incomplete.
3) Batching/autoscaler interaction: dynamic batching increased batch sizes and overloaded some pools -> fallback to quantized model paths for performance -> both latency and dim mismatch.
4) Serialization/deserialization bug: truncation of vectors when converting between float16/int8 and host format for specific hardware (rare).

QUICK CHECKS TO RUN (next):
- Check deployment tags on nodepool-eu-quant and nodepool-us-standard: kubectl get daemonset/statefulset/pods with image tags around 19:45 deploy.
- Query routing table: curl kube-internal routing-api /routing?model=text-embed-002-v2 and inspect variant weights.
- Reproduce locally forcing specific nodepool via dev-proxy to confirm 1024 output.
- Roll back rerank-deploy-2026-03-10 to previous stable and watch error rate.
- Add strict model-compatibility check in rerank-service: reject embeddings that don't match expected dim and instrument counters.

IMMEDIATE MITIGATION (notes):
- Temporarily increased strictness in rerank-service to drop/raise errors for mismatched dims (PR 187 hooks this; pinged infra to hotfix).
- Put nodepool-eu-quant into maintenance (cordon) to prevent further routing while investigating.
- Lower dynamic_batching max size to 4 to reduce queueing pressure (config change applied at 21:05 UTC).

ACTION ITEMS / OWNERS:
- Samira: confirm image tags + routing table (today).
- Liam: look at autoscaler logs and nodepool metrics (cpu/gpu utilization) for 19:30-20:45 window.
- Maya: instrument rerank-service to count dimension mismatches and add early rejection (follow-up PR 190).
- Infra: keep nodepool-eu-quant cordoned until we verify images (assigned: infra-team).

NOTES TO SELF / FRAGMENTS:
- Might be related to the 'quantization rollout' experiment we've been A/B testing. Check experiment config: exp:embed-quant-v1 weight 0.1 -> maybe accidentally ramped.
- Check feature flagging system for 'embed-variant-routing' toggles.
- If we see more 1024 outputs, capture raw payload + request-id and add to replay-store for offline analysis.

POTENTIAL LONGER-TERM FIXES:
- Enforce model schema compatibility at routing layer before sending to serving pool.
- Add a model-version header from runtime with expected dim so downstream can validate without guessing.
- Improve canary health checks for embedding shape consistency during rollouts.

LOGS / ARTIFACTS TO COLLECT (for postmortem):
- pod logs for nodepool-eu-quant for 19:30-21:00 UTC (grep request_id).
- routing API snapshots at 19:45 and 20:30 (weights + variant table).
- job-runner replay logs for failed batches.
- sample requests that returned 1024 vectors (store request_id + raw response).

END NOTES:
- Leaving this as a personal scratchpad for now. After collecting artifacts, will draft a short incident summary for the sle-summary channel.

-- Samira
